races.paceDynamic: Mollys Dolly is the only confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace from the flag without pressure. The vast majority of this field - including Dromana Mist, Dictionary Corner, Shing Shang Lily, Lady Fromentro, Moonlight Paradise, Hunskelper, Ersudaly, Rubi Tuesday, Keep The Head and Strand Street Lass - are hold-up horses who will track behind in a bunched group. With one lone leader and ten hold-up horses, this creates a tactical nightmare where the back-markers will be queuing up for racing room turning for home. This race shape heavily favours front runners and prominent racers, as Mollys Dolly will have a clear advantage despite her modest ability.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Mollys Dolly maintains a steady gallop and the hold-up horses interfere with each other
scenarios.body: The bunched field behind will struggle for room and momentum while Mollys Dolly gets first run on them all. Her tactical advantage outweighs her modest OR of 74 in this tactical race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up brigade can organize themselves and produce a sustained finish
scenarios.body: The better-rated horses like Dromana Mist or Dictionary Corner will overcome the tactical disadvantage through superior ability. Their higher ratings will tell in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get badly hampered and struggle for clear runs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than ability. Horses with the clearest passage will benefit regardless of rating.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and Mollys Dolly fades badly in the straight
scenarios.body: An unfancied hold-up horse with better stamina reserves will pick up the pieces. The tactical mess allows a bigger price to sneak through.

watchPoints.text: Watch for a cavalry charge of hold-up horses causing severe interference in the straight when ten similar styles converge
Watch Mollys Dolly's stamina reserves as she has fade warnings but will have the race run to suit from the front
Watch if any of the hold-up horses can get prominent early to avoid the traffic nightmare that awaits them
Watch for late scratches as several horses haven't run recently and conditions may not suit all connections
Watch the pace through the early stages as Mollys Dolly may go too slow and allow the field to stay in touch

races.paceDynamic: Crystal Gold will take the field along from the front at a steady gallop, with no other confirmed leaders to pressure her early. Two Pair and Miss Lia should track in prominent positions, while the majority of this field prefer to be held up including Born Bright, One Night Standard, and Simple Things. The lack of pace pressure means Crystal Gold can dictate terms through the early stages before the hold-up horses launch their challenges in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace without having to come from too far back in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Gold maintains her jumping and isn't pressured early by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: She can control the tempo and kick clear at the last, making it hard for the hold-up horses to peg her back on this going. Her style perfectly suits getting first run on a field full of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If Two Pair or Miss Lia track Crystal Gold closely and time their move perfectly at the second last
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can get into the race without using too much energy early, then outstay Crystal Gold in the final furlong. Two Pair's recent Bellewstown win shows she has the tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and Born Bright or One Night Standard get the perfect trip from the back
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells and the hold-up horses can use their turn of foot. Born Bright's dual chase wins last summer show she has the ability when fresh.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Gold stops or makes a jumping error when the field is still bunched approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where any horse in the right position can capitalize on the disruption. This creates opportunities for outsiders who get lucky positioning.

watchPoints.text: Crystal Gold could get an uncontested lead with amateur Josh Williamson and dictate throughout
Born Bright has the class edge if fit enough returning from 266 days off for in-form connections
Two Pair and Miss Lia both need to be positioned close enough to Crystal Gold to strike in the straight
Multiple runners returning from long breaks including One Night Standard (284 days) and Joshua's Daylami (391 days)
Morell River won over course and distance off lower mark and could outrun odds from the back

races.paceDynamic: Mo Ghille Mar is the confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely accompanied by Deise Crystal and Garrick Painter in the early positions. With 13 of 17 runners preferring hold-up tactics, the early pace should be manageable rather than fierce, allowing the leaders to control proceedings through the first mile. The large field of hold-up horses will create a cavalry charge from the back straight, but many will have too much to do. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those comfortable tracking the pace, as they can position close enough to strike while avoiding the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Mo Ghille Mar or Deise Crystal maintain a steady gallop without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The leader stays strong in the straight while hold-up horses struggle to make ground from too far back. Prominent racers get first run on the field and prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners go too slow and bunch the field entering the home straight
scenarios.body: A messy scramble develops with traffic problems galore, favouring those already in striking positions. The best-handicapped horses with clear runs can capitalise on the chaos.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners push the pace beyond Mo Ghille Mar's comfort zone
scenarios.body: The early leaders tire and fade, creating opportunities for the stronger stayers coming from midfield. Those with proven stamina reserves can pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-up Hero
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and the field strings out significantly
scenarios.body: The early speed merchants pay the penalty and a patient ride from the back pays dividends. A well-handicapped closer gets the perfect setup to unleash a winning burst.

watchPoints.text: Mo Ghille Mar could get an uncontested lead with so many hold-up horses behind him, making him very dangerous if allowed easy fractions
Traffic problems are inevitable in the straight with 13 hold-up horses converging from the rear, positioning will be crucial
Garrick Painter returns from 342-day absence but won easily last hurdles start and prominent style suits the race shape
Dontdooddson carries just 140lbs compared to top weights on 168lbs, significant advantage for the proven course winner
Several 7lb claimers reduce experience levels in a competitive handicap where positioning and race-reading matter greatly

races.paceDynamic: Fedneys Park looks the only confirmed front-runner in this field, likely to set an uncontested lead with the next tier of prominent runners (Butch Coolidge, Final Decision, Menas Miracle, Craic Eile) sitting just behind rather than challenging early. This creates a sustainable gallop that won't overly test stamina reserves over 2m1f. With most of the field committed to hold-up tactics and needing to make ground from the back, the lack of early pace pressure clearly favours those who can track the leaders and strike from prominent positions rather than relying on late kicks from rear.

scenarios.body: Gamigin or Bossing It capitalize on their proven finishing kicks as the pace collapses, sweeping past tired leaders. Their class advantage shows when the race becomes a true test.

scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble with no clear tactical advantage, allowing an outsider like Final Decision to benefit from the confusion after his long break. Form lines become unreliable in stop-start conditions.

races.paceDynamic: Jackmoon will likely set a comfortable early gallop as the only confirmed front runner, with prominent racers Jetaway Nana, Keep Em Quite, and Dalmatic tracking close behind. The large field of 17 runners includes predominantly hold-up horses who will be looking for cover in the early stages over this stamina-testing 3m trip. With no genuine pace pressure on Jackmoon and the majority of the field sitting back, this sets up for a tactical affair that will develop into a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and strong finishers who can produce a late kick, as the moderate early pace will leave plenty in reserve for those with finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate throughout and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The patient tactics suit the numerous hold-up horses who can unleash late runs. Strong stayers like Beggars Rock and Teenage Kiss can time their challenges perfectly when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front End Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Jackmoon gets away with a very soft lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the sudden injection of pace. Prominent racers who can go with the move have the best chance of bridging the gap.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway and becomes a true staying test
scenarios.body: The 3m trip sorts out the genuine stayers from the speed horses as many tire in the closing stages. Only those with proven stamina reserves can sustain their effort to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to follow Jackmoon early and the pace becomes unsustainable
scenarios.body: The early pace battle leaves the front runners vulnerable to late closers who have been given an easy ride in behind. Fresh finishers can pick up the pieces in a slowly-run finish.

races.paceDynamic: Workahead will dictate terms from the front with no obvious pace pressure in this small field. The confirmed front-runner can bowl along at a comfortable gallop with Ma Jacks Hill and Chosen Shant likely tracking prominently but not applying early heat. This sets up a tactical affair where the hold-up horses Supersundae, Wild Bill Hickok and Reiki Revolution can get into contention turning for home. The lack of genuine pace pressure strongly favours the closers who can produce their finishing kicks off what should be a sedate gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Workahead dictates at a steady tempo without being challenged early.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing speed in the final half-mile. Quality prevails as the better-rated runners with pace to spare capitalize on the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Workahead Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner maintains his advantage and finds extra when challenged.
scenarios.body: Having established a comfortable lead, he proves hard to peg back despite the moderate early pace. His fitness edge from regular racing shows as others struggle to close the gap.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill or Chosen Shant press Workahead and quicken the tempo.
scenarios.body: The increased pace plays into the hands of horses sitting in behind the leaders who can pounce. Those tracking closest benefit from being in the right position when the race develops.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses refuse to commit early and create a stop-start rhythm.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence with positioning crucial rather than raw ability. Jockey tactics and ground position determine the outcome more than form ratings.

The sustained pace will stretch the field significantly in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours patient hold-up horses with proven stamina who can finish powerfully when the front-runners weaken.

runners_data.name: Saoirses Choice
runners_data.comment: Debutante is likely one to watch if getting a run; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; first foal; dam 6f AW winner (RPR 59), half-sister to 1m4f Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner Palace Rock; a dual-purpose pedigree; debutante is likely one to watch if getting a run

runners_data.name: C'Est Elle
runners_data.comment: Third on bumper debut at Thurles (hvy); a leading player once handling this faster surface
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up on second point start last year and ran creditably on bumper debut at Thurles in February; should have improved from that and be a leading player once handling this faster surface.

runners_data.name: The Besty Woman
runners_data.comment: The form of her bumper run was franked; top amateur takes over and looks a leading player
runners_data.spotlight: Put up respectable efforts in two maiden hurdles; better form on bumper debut when didn't get a clear run under an inexperienced rider; that winner has scored again since; top amateur aboard today and looks a leading player.

runners_data.name: Whizz Bizz
runners_data.comment: Was 9l behind The Besty Woman on debut but can improve from that and go closer today
runners_data.spotlight: Comes from a decent dual-purpose pedigree; finished 9l behind The Besty Woman on debut at Cork but can improve plenty from that and go closer today.

runners_data.name: Morning Express
runners_data.comment: Point winner; fifth here on bumper debut; should build on that and run another solid race
runners_data.spotlight: Late-starter was an easy winner of her second point run before a respectable fifth here on bumper debut; should build on that and run another solid race.

runners_data.name: Whiskey Fever
runners_data.comment: Failed to win in five point starts and beaten a long way on bumper debut; can't be fancied
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to win in five point starts and beaten a long way on bumper debut so can't be fancied.

runners_data.name: Bridgie Browne
runners_data.comment: Beaten a long way on debut at Clonmel and can only be watched
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a long way on debut at Clonmel and can only be watched.

runners_data.name: Our Sara
runners_data.comment: Some improvement on second bumper start at Bellewstown last month; needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some improvement on second bumper start at Bellewstown on return last month; beaten 15l then so will have to take another sizeable step forward.

runners_data.name: Green Me Granny
runners_data.comment: Tailed-off on debut at Cork six days ago and would need a transformation in that time
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed-off on debut at Cork six days ago and would need a transformation in that time to score; cheekpieces.
